description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
When Twilight Shepherd enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
